items.name: Flen Christmas Sleepover 2018

venue.name: [Aktivitetshuset Skjortan](https://flen.se/uppleva-gora/aktivitetshuset-skjortan/)
venue.details: On the second floor, in the smaller conference hall called "Lilla Manschetten".

items.information: Varmt välkomna till den första upplagan av Flen Christmas Sleepover 2018! Det blir en tävling som sträcker sig från fredag kväll till och med söndag med många rundor av 14 grenar. De som önskar kan boka plats för att sova på golvet i en närliggande lokal. Läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida innan ni anmäler er, då dessa innehåller mycket nyttig information om tävlingen! Welcome to the first Flen Christmas Sleepover! This will be a competition ranging from Friday evening to Sunday with many rounds in 14 events. It is possible to book a spot for sleeping on the floor in a nearby venue. Please proceed to read all the tabs before registering as they contain a lot of usual information about the competition!

items.information: Friday, saturday and sunday, will order pizza for lunch. The fee collector will ask you about pizza and you can give him the order. The pizza will be payed separated. At the registration you can support the association "Asociatia Romana de Speedcubing" with a contribution and you will get a cubing prize. More details on http://www.speedcubing.ro Prizes Certificates and medals for top 3 of each event and for the fastest girl, youngest competitor, oldest competitor and fastest competitor of each country (who register until 11.11.2018).
